name: the Concourse
basis: Vanta's own world of BABEL, from the Mabry Curve roleplay: a living tower of themed floors wearing the skin of an unreleased full-dive game.
summary: Floor Zero of the tower, where the arrivals land: a city under a gold-veined dome so high it has weather, with the great white Waystone in its plaza, the guild row, the market streets and the east gate onto the Stair. A Safe Zone covers all of it. Since the Turning it looks almost exactly like BABEL's Floor Zero.

intensity.voice: pulpy and mythic in a modern frame: omens, weather and System panes, where every win carries a bill and desire is a power with a price

mabry-curve-2026-10.title: BABEL written for Prospero's Dungeon from Vanta's Mabry Curve archive
mabry-curve-2026-10.license: Vanta's own setting; all rights reserved
mabry-curve-2026-10.note: Places, people and customs from the Mabry Curve story, hidden files and side cast (dungeon/world/packages/babel/sources.md). Names the story does not give are new.

neighborhoods.name: the Waystone plaza
neighborhoods.summary: The broad round plaza at the heart of Floor Zero, with the great white Waystone in the middle and the Roll carved at its top. Arrivals stand here looking up at the dome; everyone else stands here looking at the arrivals.

neighborhoods.name: the market streets
neighborhoods.summary: Stall-packed streets running off the plaza under banners and cookfire smoke, at their fullest on Fire Market day: skewers, cloth, starter kits, maps of floors that may not look like that any more.

neighborhoods.name: the guild row
neighborhoods.summary: A street of guild halls east of the plaza, tall narrow fronts with banners hung from the upper windows, most faded past reading. The Landing is the last and least impressive.

neighborhoods.name: the east gate
neighborhoods.summary: The gate onto the Stair, with MIND THE STAIR painted over the arch in the oldest lettering on the floor and the lift cage swinging on its chains beyond. Porters, toll touts and people saying goodbye.

neighborhoods.name: the Lamp Quarter
neighborhoods.summary: Lodging houses, cook-shops and taprooms in the lanes behind the market, lit all night by lamps on brackets: where climbers sleep when they are not in a guild, and where natives sell the only food that tastes.

places.name: the Concourse Waystone
places.summary: A great white standing stone with light at its heart. Touch it to attune: your return point, the quest board, a class confirmed. The Roll of arrivals is carved at the top, newest first; Nth Floor's maker's mark, NF, is cut small into its foot.
spots: the maker's mark at the foot

places.name: the plaza
places.summary: Flagstones worn smooth around the Stone, the dome far overhead with weather in it and bells hung in the haze. Plate armor, rags, and now and then a Texas Longhorns hoodie.

places.name: Hamid's skewer cart
places.summary: A charcoal cart half a block from the plaza, meat on iron forks over coals, and Hamid in his leather apron daring you to complain. Plain meat: to a climber it tastes of ash.

places.name: the Fire Market rows
places.summary: The market streets on Fire Market day, the best trading day of the week: stalls three deep, starter kits resold, cloth, lamps, maps, and debts changing hands.

places.name: Brask and Daughters
places.summary: Armorers and outfitters with a stall front and a forge behind: blades, mail, packs, and gear graded on BABEL's ladder since the Turning, which the Brask daughters resent.

places.name: the Landing
places.summary: Darla Kinney's guild in a squat domed bathhouse of green-veined marble, its bronze plaque scratched over in block capitals. The pools are drained: bedrolls in the shallow end, a long table in the deep end, a cookfire in the old hot bath venting through a hole in the dome, fish mosaics missing tiles like teeth. It still smells faintly of chlorine.
spots: the long table in the deep end

places.name: the guild halls
places.summary: Bigger guilds than the Landing, behind faded banners: halls that recruit arrivals on the plaza, buy what they know about the floors, and do not like a veteran guild getting ahead of them on the Turning.

places.name: the east gate
places.summary: The arch onto the Stair, MIND THE STAIR over it. Beyond, the shaft as wide as a stadium, the stair spiraling its wall and the iron lift cage on its chains. The operator in the leather cap calls the floors.

places.name: the porters' yard
places.summary: Where porters wait for loads going up or down the Stair, and where you can hire one, or a guide, or someone who says he is a guide.

places.name: Osk's Kitchen
places.summary: A cook-shop run by a native Cook whose dishes carry a System effect, so they are the only meals on the street that taste of anything to a climber. There is always a queue of the Unhungry, and Osk charges for it.

places.name: the Tap and Tally
places.summary: A low taproom where natives drink and climbers come for the talk, since the beer is ash in their mouths. Dice, gossip about the floors, and a board of the missing.

places.name: the Pallet House
places.summary: A lodging house of straw pallets by the night or the week, for arrivals with no guild, a few Talents, and nobody to vouch for them.

places.name: Sallis's counting house
places.summary: Ivo Sallis lends Talents against what you will be worth, and writes it down. His terms are fair the first week.

places.name: the scrivener's stall
places.summary: A native with good eyes and a ladder who will search the Roll for a name, copy it out, and tell you how long it has been there, for a Talent. For more, she will tell you who else has asked.

places.name: the water sellers
places.summary: Natives with yokes and dippers working the edge of the plaza, selling cups of water to arrivals who have not yet learned they do not need it.

places.name: the guild mess
places.summary: A long room off the guild row where any registered climber can eat at a common table, and every guild on the row listens in.

places.name: the gate tea stall
places.summary: A tin-roofed stall under the arch where porters drink strong tea before a carry and the touts work the line.

transit.name: On foot
transit.summary: The plaza to the east gate is a quarter hour.

transit.name: The lift cage
transit.summary: Up one to Varrow or down one to St. Agathe's, from the east gate, to Waystones you have touched.

careers.name: Stall keeper
careers.summary: Running a cart or a stall on the market streets, and paying the rows their rent.

careers.name: Cook
careers.summary: Cooking food with a System effect, the only meals climbers can taste.

careers.name: Stair porter
careers.summary: Carrying loads up and down the Stair for whoever pays.

careers.name: Cage hand
careers.summary: Working the lift cage's chains and lever.

careers.name: Guild climber
careers.summary: Climbing for a guild: escorts, quests, floor runs, and sharing what comes back.

careers.name: Scrivener
careers.summary: Copying the Roll, writing letters and contracts for those who cannot.

careers.name: Armorer
careers.summary: Forging and fitting arms and armor, graded on the ladder.

careers.name: Lodging keeper
careers.summary: Renting pallets and rooms by the night.

careers.name: Rent man
careers.summary: Collecting the market rows' stall rents.

employers.name: the Landing
employers.summary: Darla Kinney's guild of veterans from before the Turning.

employers.name: the guild halls
employers.summary: The bigger guilds on the row.

employers.name: Osk's Kitchen
employers.summary: The cook-shop with food that tastes.

career_hubs.name: The market and the gate
career_hubs.summary: Most native wages on the Concourse come from selling to climbers or carrying for them.

climate.summary: Under the dome: mild, smoky, with its own weather high up. Rain falls from the haze some days and never reaches the plaza dry.

months.note: The dome is gray for days at a time.
The bells ring in the weather.

local_color.name: Fire Market
local_color.summary: The best trading day of the week. Cookfires never go out and the rows collect double.

local_color.name: Mind the stair
local_color.summary: What the Concourse says instead of goodbye, from the words over the east gate.

local_color.name: Down somewhere worse
local_color.summary: Anyone not on the Roll by nightfall came down somewhere worse, or did not come down.

local_color.name: The Unhungry
local_color.summary: Natives sell climbers food they cannot taste and drink they do not need, and climbers buy it anyway, for the company.

local_color.name: New wave
local_color.summary: Said with a sigh whenever an arrival does something stupid, or flashes red in a Safe Zone.

local_color.name: The white ring
local_color.summary: Old natives look twice at white-ringed eyes. Ask why and they say a big one came down in an earlier wave, and something bad followed.

local_color.name: The Long House
local_color.summary: Before the Turning, the Stone greeted arrivals like a tent preacher: Welcome, child, to the Long House.

local_color.name: Never go down to St. Agathe's
local_color.summary: Every veteran's first piece of advice.

prices.item: A skewer cart and a morning's stock

notables.name: Hamid
notables.about: Runs a skewer cart by the plaza and refers to himself in the third person. He owes the market rows his stall rent and fears big arrivals with white-ringed eyes.
notables.wants: to make his Fire Market take

notables.name: Darla Kinney
notables.about: A veteran from before the Turning in a Dallas Cowboys jacket, Lv 14 ▸ Rank D. Wants leverage on the new skin, and lies to keep useful people close.
notables.wants: someone who understands the new skin before the guilds do

notables.name: Ruth Ann Teel
notables.about: A Delver who has kept the Landing's stores for eleven years and watched a man named Teague over its cookfire for two.

notables.name: Danny Oyelaran
notables.about: The Landing's newest, a rabbit-eared Therian at 31% of F.
notables.wants: to rank up before the rules change again

notables.name: Sister Pia
notables.about: A mouthless Hollow who talks on a slate and knows Darla is hiding something.
notables.wants: someone to ask Darla about Teague

notables.name: Osk Lindqvist
notables.about: A native Cook whose food tastes to climbers. She knows every arrival who has eaten at her counter and what they could afford.
notables.wants: to be paid what her cooking is worth

notables.name: Cobb
notables.about: The operator in the leather cap who calls the floors. He has seen everyone go up, and knows who came back.

notables.name: Ivo Sallis
notables.about: Lends Talents to arrivals against what they will be worth, at terms that are fair for a week.

notables.name: Greer Brask
notables.about: The eldest Brask daughter, who grades blades on the ladder and hates doing it.
notables.wants: the old way of pricing back
